basic_info.description: Price reduced! Move-in condition & low monthly fees. In-unit washer & dryer. Unit has updated circuit breakers, newer applicances & window shades included. Quiet top unit at the rear of the building. Bright unit with windows in every room. Dedicated parking with automatic garage door opener and drive directly to space. Seller motivated. Walking distance to Farmers Market, Alemany Gardens,Bernal Mt. hiking trails,Precita Park, a stones throw away from dining and shopping on Courtland Ave. The very popular H Mart is a few miles away. Centrally located with easy access to 101 or 280. Parking included with TIC. Well maintained building with property manager & pride of ownership.
